message: Supervised model training aborted: Insufficient verified ground-truth labels.

audit.decision_rationale: Ground-truth verification count N=6 is below the statistical threshold (N>=50) required for generalizable supervised multi-class learning. Training on N=6 would cause severe overfitting, memorization of single inspector cases, and invalid evaluation metrics.

governance_enforcement: In accordance with CivicPulse AI Phase 3 Governance, automated rules and CV proxy labels are NOT permitted to serve as training targets. Awaiting field inspector verification volume.
